tools.name: submit_agent_output_for_check
tools.description: Submit the exact HELICS context packet used by the agent plus a structured agent_recommendation response. The server validates evidence IDs, quality, source labels, unknowns, approval requirements, and prohibited command fields before human review. Body: {"context": {...}, "output": {...}}

tools.name: get_review_state
tools.description: Return the checked agent response, validation gate, human review history, and pending recheck request.

tools.name: get_recheck_request
tools.description: Retrieve the operator's structured request for the AI Agent to re-read context and correct errors.

tools.name: get_agent_output_schema
tools.description: Return the JSON Schema required for a structured agent_recommendation response.

tools.name: record_human_review
tools.description: Record accept, request_recheck, or reject feedback. Recheck and reject require operator feedback. Body: {"decision":"request_recheck","issue_types":[],"feedback":"..."}

tools.name: load_live_grid_context
tools.description: Load the latest context from the local HELICS Agent Gateway at port 8766 for use in a checked submission.

agent_rules: Submit the exact context packet used for reasoning so evidence references can be resolved.
Use evidence_ids for the summary, every claim, and every possible solution.
Keep observed, simulated, inferred, and recommended source_kind labels distinct.
Do not state that an equipment limit is exceeded unless the limit and unit are present and supported.
Return possible solutions as advisory options with risks, constraints_to_check, and approval_required=true.
Never include direct control commands, target setpoints, or execute_now fields.
If a recheck request exists, retrieve it and submit corrected output rather than defending unsupported claims.
